title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 3
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 3 restores keyboard shortcuts as real locally managed portable settings. It removes the inherited PowerToys Settings lockout and makes shortcuts opt-in for new preference files.
changes: Removes the stale tooltip and blanket lockout claiming keyboard shortcuts are controlled by PowerToys Settings.
Reconnects supported lock, reconnect, all-PC, Easy Mouse toggle, and machine-switch controls to the adjacent portable preferences file.
Defaults every keyboard shortcut to disabled in newly created preferences while preserving shortcut choices already saved by existing users.
Hides obsolete Show Settings, Exit, and custom screen-capture shortcut rows that have no active backing command in this portable build.
Persists shortcut edits immediately and updates the program, About, diagnostics, release metadata, and documentation to version 1.0.0-rc.3.
testing: Start RC3 in a fresh folder and confirm every shortcut initially displays Disable, including the machine-switch radio choice.
Open Other Options and confirm the shortcut controls are usable and no PowerToys Settings tooltip appears.
Set one or more Ctrl+Alt letter shortcuts, close and restart MWB, and confirm the selections persist.
Exercise each enabled shortcut and confirm Disable stops it from firing.
Confirm Show Settings, Exit, and custom screen-capture shortcut rows are absent rather than greyed out.
Upgrade an existing RC2 preferences file and confirm its saved settings and shortcut choices remain intact.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.3.
Run the same RC3 EXE on both computers and briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, and reconnect behavior.
